column1: Build rules to preserve the swap path
• Isolate the 5 swap surfaces as their own small components. Don't inline hero, nav order, primary CTA, or footer copy into pages.
• Don't build Option 2 versions yet (YAGNI). Just keep the seams clean so the swap is a focused day, not a rebuild.
• AI Studio stays first-class even though it's secondary today — its own polished landing area, its own SEO indexing, a discoverable home-page CTA.
• Prefer copy that survives both positions. 'Designed by us. Visualized by you.' beats 'Premium interior design studio'.
• Move marketing copy (hero headlines, CTA labels, meta tags) into Sanity. Editorial swap > code swap.
• Track AI Studio engagement: sign-ups, generations per visitor, conversion to consultation. The swap should be data-driven.
